title: Feedback-Controlled Magnon-Atom Entanglement and Photon Statistics
summary: Quantum systems face inherent challenges in achieving precise control, and solving the Schrödinger equation is often intractable for complex hybrid platforms. Here, for the first time, we introduce a magnon into a feedback-controlled quantum system. To solve the dynamics numerically and efficiently, we employ a Long Short-Term Memory network, a machine learning approach, to propagate the probability amplitudes to the steady state.
